title.full: How to apply for Additional Premium Support

summary.text: You will be invited to apply if your MediSave is insufficient. The invitation letter explains how. You do not need to apply early.

details.heading: What APS helps with
details.body: APS provides financial assistance to members who cannot afford their premiums after premium subsidies and MediSave use, and have limited family support.

details.heading: No early application needed
details.body: You do not need to apply for APS before you are invited.

steps.name: Wait for an invitation
steps.text: Wait for an invitation letter if you have insufficient MediSave. It will include details on how to apply for APS.

steps.name: Follow the letter
steps.text: Use the application details in your invitation letter to apply for APS.

details on the application process will be included in the invitation letter.
